ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (approx. 5%) to low-intensity pixels (approx. 95%) across the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular serration and small tissue loss along the trailing edge; dense white scarring on the distal tips.
